items.headline: Camden Coleman, George Pettaway lead unbeaten James Madison to 45-17 romp over Marshall
items.description: — Camden Coleman threw three touchdown passes, and George Pettaway rushed for two scores and a career-high 206 yards to lead unbeaten James Madison to a 45-17 victory over Marshall on Saturday in the Thundering Herd's Sun Belt Conference opener.

items.headline: Jorge Diaz Nicolas' field goal in final seconds lifts Marshall over Gardner-Webb 36-35
items.description: — Jorge Diaz Nicolas kicked a 32-yard field goal with six seconds left and Marshall rallied to beat upset-minded Gardner-Webb 36-35 on Saturday.
